title: Add Configurable Request Logger Middleware
description: Provides built‑in request logging with customizable formats, log levels and optional file output with rotation. Improves observability and debugging without adding external dependencies, fitting yantraverse's zero‑dependency philosophy.
testCases: Verify that the logger outputs the default combined format to console for a GET request
Verify that custom format and log level settings produce the expected log string
Verify that file logging creates/rotates log files when a filePath is provided
Verify that the logger does not interfere with other middleware and correctly passes control to next handler
acceptance: All tests pass; logger writes correct output to console or file per configuration; no unhandled errors; performance impact is negligible (<1 ms per request on average); documentation updated with usage examples and changelog entry.
reason: Enhanced logging is critical for production monitoring and troubleshooting, directly addressing operational needs while maintaining the framework's lightweight, zero‑dependency design.
